from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfitData(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data for a single company from a financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company reported in the document")
    securities_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock market security code if provided")
    profit_metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact text label of the profit line item in the report (e.g. '利润总额')")
    total_profit: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the total profit reported")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit of the reported amount (e.g., 'CNY', '元')")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The time period the report covers (e.g., 'Q1 2024')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_profits: list[CompanyProfitData]
